summary:
Reviewed w121's commits 3593951 and 82ad81f (25b2223..2a21ecb), the same ones review 5 reviewed. No commit followed the person's answer to review 5: a90f980 moved w121 to done and touched only the work-item file and the log.
Important, fix now (still open): r65 fails under -n auto. GUARANTEES is set only in the xdist workers' collection hook, so the controller keeps exit 5. Probe .shop/scratch/w121-6-review/probe_xdist.py: serial run exit 0, -n 2 exit 5. work run's merge check runs -n auto, so a guarantees-only work-item cannot merge. The fix is the person's answer: decide in pytest_sessionfinish from accepts and the spec, and add an -n 2 test.
Observations: an empty or unparsable accepts: deselects everything and exits 0; test_supervision.py is outside the fileset.
No test was weakened and the retirement is allowed. Both allowances hold. ruff and vulture are clean, and no file is over 300 lines.
questions: Important, scripts/work_items.py:112-113,128-131: r65's success exit still relies on a stash set only in xdist workers, so `pytest -n 2 --work-item <guarantees-only>` exits 5 (reproduced). The fix the person's answer of 2026-10-24 asked for was never committed (w121 was moved to done by a90f980 without it).
